_about: Texts that stay as they are on the /en/ and /ru/ pages (brand, product and package names, language names, abbreviations, names in examples, titles of Serbian sources, the media kit's texts in the other languages …), each with the reason. Key as in en.json. A translation in en.json / ru.json wins over an entry here (e.g. Novi Sad stays in English, Нови-Сад in Russian). QA counts a kept text as allowed, never as "Serbian left".

11ljhe3.sr: Evolako rešava punjenje električnog automobila za ljude koji žive u zgradama. Na parking mesto ili u garažu ugrađuje pojačanu utičnicu sa sertifikovanim MID brojilom ili wallbox 11 kW (MID brojilo po izboru), daje šablone papira za skupštinu stanara ili vlasnika garaže i svakog meseca obračunava struju po ceni sa računa EPS-a, bez marže. Paketi sa osnovnom ugradnjom pored razvodne table koštaju od 39.000 RSD sa PDV-om, a ugradnja traje jedan radni dan. Evolako radi u celoj Srbiji.

1s2jplc.sr: Evolako solves electric car charging for people who live in apartment buildings. At a parking space or in a garage it installs a heavy-duty socket with a MID-certified meter or an 11 kW wallbox (MID meter optional), provides document templates for the residents’ assembly or the garage owner, and every month bills electricity at the price on the EPS bill, with no markup. Packages with basic installation next to the distribution board start at RSD 39,000 including VAT, and installation takes one working day. Evolako works all over Serbia.
